title: ID0430237-DC/Si-D/FI-[MP / P9 170001030] Charger out of order
description:
Customer states:
I noticed that the charger 170001030 in KSM Säkylä first went into the SafetyRelay_QA26 fault mode and then, after a reset, dropped out of the connections and has not returned to the lines. Can you connect to the device?
Charger seems to be online in SCB but I cannot read logs or get connection to the router. Trying to do reboot via the SCB does not work.

additional_info.subject: RE: ID0430237-DC/Si-D/FI-[MP / P9 170001030] OCPP out of order CRM:02681000290
additional_info.body:
Hello Sakari,
We would like to inform you that the charger is currently offline on the SCB, and as a result, we can not do anything remotely and unable to download the logs at this time.
The best would be to have someone on site to check
The router is connected to internet.
The charger is powered.
And kindly refer the below points which might be the reason to out the charger on SCB.
Then there might be Internet issue with the Siemens router and probably because of failover function the WAN is switched from Cellular to Ethernet.
I would recommend doing a Hard reset from "OCPP" (If charger is connected to OCPP server) or a local reboot will bring them up again.
Data service of mobile network operator might not be available.
- SIM card might be disabled / expired (Please check if the SIM card is inserted incorrectly by cleaning and then reinserting it into the XF3 and XF4 router.)
- monthly data volume exhausted
- signal strength got weak due to changed radio transmission conditions
- in case of M2M contracts is IP not enabled
There might be backend related issues.
- Backend changed the settings for the affected charger
- OCPP server on Backend side unavailable
It could be Teltonika related issues.
- Router switches to a wrong network service (e.g. 3G instead of 4G)
- Hardware failure of Router
- Router software crash
We thank you for your time and patience in advance.
With best regards,
eMobility Tech Support Team -
Ankita

additional_info.subject: RE: ID0430237-DC/Si-D/FI-[MP / P9 170001030] OCPP out of order CRM:02681000290
additional_info.body:
Hello,
Router is not connected to the internet. Charger is powered on.
No OCPP connection is available. Technician went on site. Multiple local reboots was attempted and did not fix the issue.
Sim card was taken out and inserted again. But this is not probably the issue since both routers stopped working at the same time.
Backend setting have not been changed and the backend is unavailable.
Likely not hardware failure of Router or Router software crash. Since happened both at the same time. Both routers are receiving power.
No fuses were tripped and all cable were connected properly.
This is important. The screen of the charger looked like this. Even when opining the door the screen stayed like this and no “reboot” “Shutdown” screen showed. Lights of the charger were blinking/breathing white color. This was the case even after multiple reboots.
So the screen is stuck in this state and charger is unusable. No connection on either SCB or OCPP.
Best regards
Sakari Harjunpää

additional_info.subject: RE: ID0430237-DC/Si-D/FI-[MP / P9 170001030] OCPP out of order CRM:02681000290
additional_info.body:
Hi Sakari,
I hope you’re doing well.
Since the charger has been offline on SCB since 2025-04-16T19:30, we are currently unable to perform any remote troubleshooting. Based on your description and the screen display, the issue may be related to the firmware or configuration.
We recommend performing a factory reset of both routers followed by reconfiguration. If this does not resolve the issue, we suggest proceeding with a CFast flashing, which may help restore the charger to a healthy state. So, please carry spare routers and a CFast card, as a precaution. If the initial CFast flashing does not work, testing with a new CFast card is advisable.
For your reference, please see the following Knowledge Article for the CFast flashing procedure:
KA Link:
Knowledge Article: Knowledge Article for ISP: Emobility_SICD_SW_CfastCard_Corupted - Dynamics 365
We will attach the configuration file for this unit in the notes for the CFast flashing activity.
Additionally, please kindly carry a USB keyboard when visiting the site to assist with any manual operations.
